# Human Development Reports

> > The official UNDP platform for Human Development Index research, multidimensional poverty measurement, and development indicators with emerging focus on AI implications and climate resilience.

The Human Development Reports Office (HDRO) publishes annual flagship reports and maintains comprehensive global development data through interactive platforms. The site features cutting-edge research on AI's impact on human development, climate-linked poverty analysis, and subnational development estimation using satellite imagery.

## Key Topics

- Human Development Index (HDI)
- Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)
- Human Development Report 2025
- AI and human development
- Gender Social Norms Index (GSNI)
- Climate change and development
- Satellite imagery and AI
- Country development rankings
- Composite indices
- Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
- Inequality-adjusted HDI (IHDI)
- Capabilities approach
- Global development data
- Agricultural projections
- Food security

## Flagship Reports & Research

- [Human Development Report 2025](https://hdr.undp.org/content/human-development-report-2025): 2025 HDR exploring AI's implications for human development and capabilities
- [2025 Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)](https://hdr.undp.org/content/2025-global-multidimensional-poverty-index-mpi): 2025 MPI report linking poverty data with climate hazards and exposure
- [2023 Gender Social Norms Index (GSNI)](https://hdr.undp.org/content/2023-gender-social-norms-index-gsni): GSNI report on gender bias, social norms, and women's empowerment
- [Towards 2026 Human Development Report](https://hdr.undp.org/reports-and-publications/towards-2026-human-development-report): Preview of 2026 HDR on planetary systems and human-nature relationships
- [Reports and Publications](https://hdr.undp.org/reports-and-publications): Central hub for HDR reports, MPI, and development research publications

## Data & Interactive Tools

- [Data Center](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center): Interactive data hub for HDI, MPI, SDGs, and composite development indices
- [Human Development Index](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/human-development-index): HDI methodology, rankings, and data download resources
- [Country Insights](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/country-insights): Interactive country data explorer with development indicators
- [Composite Indices](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/composite-indices): HDI, MPI, IHDI, and planetary pressure composite indices
- [Human Climate Horizons Data and Insights Platform](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/human-climate-horizons-data-and-insights-platform): Climate data platform for agricultural projections and food security
- [2025 Global Survey on AI and Human Development](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/2025-global-survey-ai-and-human-development): Global survey data on public perception of AI and human development

## Research & Methodology

- [About Human Development](https://hdr.undp.org/about/human-development): Human development approach, capabilities theory, and frameworks
- [HDRO Co-Authors Cutting-Edge Research Using AI and Satellite Imagery](https://hdr.undp.org/content/hdro-co-authors-cutting-edge-research-using-ai-and-satellite-imagery-estimate-hdi-highly): Research on AI and satellite imagery for subnational HDI estimation
- [Documentation and Downloads](https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/documentation-and-downloads): API documentation, statistical tables, and data downloads

## About HDRO

- [About HDRO](https://hdr.undp.org/about-hdro): HDRO mission, overview, and organizational information
- [News](https://hdr.undp.org/news): News archive covering HDR reports, climate, AI, and development
